mmproj._note: Mandatory: without the projector the model sees no image.

launch.name: ctx-size
launch.description: Context window; the request carries two images (the crop and the candidate render), so it is much longer than a text-only decision request. 16384 holds both images' 4096 tokens and the candidate text; a wider window buys only KV cache.

launch.name: batch-size
launch.description: Prompt processing batch; sized for the two-image prompt.

launch.name: ubatch-size
launch.description: Micro-batch; the prompt may be evaluated in batches like a normal causal model. 512 keeps the working set on the card instead of splitting the graph onto the host.

launch.name: flash-attn
launch.description: Flash attention on; the default off path materializes the full attention buffer and inflates the memory requirement.

decision._note: The visual-diff decision (docs/31): the app sends the crop, the candidate rendered back into an image, and the candidate text; the task wording is baked into the model's prompt, so the request profile stays empty and the profile ships no question texts. The noul head answers P(candidate is consistent) in one pass — Ok above the threshold, Mismatch below. The thresholds are measured on the OCR_TEST corpus (177 blocks, MinerU2.5-Pro recognition, the app's own CandidateRenderer renders, llama.cpp b11946) — the knee of the per-type FN/FP(t) curve, one caught error for at most one false alarm (OCRtest/decision_models/test 2/iteration8); the run's report also records that the render leg rejects every table (all p < 0.02), so the table value is the edge of the measured region and tables keep landing on Mismatch.
